_notes: Table is keyed by weight carried ABOVE your encumbrance allowance ('encumbered weight', from Table 1.1.2a Strength), not absolute weight.
Max. Movement is a fraction of the character's base movement rate (from ancestry), not an absolute distance. Full=1.0, Three Quarter=0.75, Half=0.5, Quarter=0.25, Cannot Move=0.0.
Armour sets a separate maximum movement rate (the movement cap in Table 1.4.2.3g) that applies independent of all weight calculations, due to bulkiness; it is the cap even when unencumbered.
Magical armour you are wearing does not count toward encumbrance and allows a movement cap 30ft faster than normal, up to a max of 120ft.
In OSRIC coins are heavy: ten coins weigh one pound (a 'coin' = 0.1 lb).
Example (docs 1.5.3.2): a character with base Movement Rate 120 who is encumbered to half movement moves at 60, and can hike 12 miles/day in level terrain (60 x 0.2 miles per day).
Being at the maximum encumbrance category (Cannot Move / 121+ over) also prevents charging in combat unless mounted on a less-encumbered mount.
